name: Trailer Fetcher
description: Finds and downloads missing local movie trailers from YouTube via yt-dlp.
overview: Finds and downloads missing local movie trailers from YouTube via yt-dlp.

versions.changelog: Clearer cookies-file guidance on the settings page - no browser exposes a plain "cookies.txt" to point to (Firefox stores cookies in an SQLite database, not a text file); names the actual export extension needed ("Get cookies.txt LOCALLY"). Also fixed the catalog logo being cropped and replaced it with a solid-background badge.
